title: The EU accepts X's plan to meet DSA transparency obligations and give researchers access to data, giving X six months to implement it, following a €120M fine (Foo Yun Chee/Reuters)
summary: Foo Yun Chee / Reuters: The EU accepts X's plan to meet DSA transparency obligations and give researchers access to data, giving X six months to implement it, following a €120M fine — The European Union, which fined Elon Musk's social media network X €120 million ($137.2 million) last year …
